title: Can't Receive Emails
creator: nalanohj
content: I have Thunderbird installed on a desktop and laptop (both running Windows 11) and an Android phone. I can no longer receive emails on the two PCs, though the phone still works OK. When I send a test email to myself it goes out OK and appears in my webmail, but does not appear in my Sent box. I tried doing Repair Folder on my desktop Inbox. This caused all the existing messages in the inbox to disappear, though the folder size still shows as 400Mb. I have a secondary email address which I use occasionally (a gmail address). This is still working OK. All help gratefully received. Alan
